summary: Shared storefront customer and commerce features implemented across template families with explicit policy migration, current-scope login locking and local acceptance evidence.
noAssistantImpact: Customer identity, OTP, receipt capability proofs, request recovery and customer-initiated actions remain excluded from model tools and ordinary model input. Existing domain commands remain canonical. Shared UI and template configuration do not grant permission. Existing Host/published Site/active release/Store scope and current entitlement checks remain; new login effects recheck publication under a Site lock while valid session/history/receipt reads do not depend on the selected template or new-intake policy. No new protected merchant procedure, assistant capability, provider activation or deployment. Neutral feature settings retain existing Owner/Admin draft/save/publication authority and explicit consent; design generation cannot silently alter operational configuration.

docs.note: Existing customer/request/Site records and JSON composition storage; no Prisma schema edit in this extraction.

evidence.result: Independent login/order configuration, legacy normalization, unknown versions and entitlement/channel refusal pass in offline tests.

The shared scope resolver interface passes template-switch/history continuity, foreign-host denial, invalid publication/pin/runtime refusal and exact active-Store scope tests with isolated adapters. This is not connected transaction/concurrency proof.

Owner-authorized 27-work-package local extraction contract preserves customer/session/token/bag compatibility, immutable releases and no-deployment boundary. Full template/UI/transaction acceptance remains open until the final phase.

Explicit migration preserves disabled intake/privacy and immutable input, every selectable template preserves configuration, AI proposals cannot change feature policy. Existing save/publish/consent remains authoritative; no new assistant tool.
Shared customer/receipt/checkout SSR and moved commerce baseline pass. Presentation/config injection grants no effect authority; no new assistant procedure or domain writer.

Every selectable exact pin renders the shared historical account route in legacy and migrated compositions. Preview configuration cannot re-enable disabled order intake; all preview effects remain inert. Fast203/1112 and Storefront types pass; full API test-fixture errors remain disclosed in plan.

All11 connected cases covered across initial and corrected focused runs. Real queued OTP verification waits on Site publication lock and fails after policy change; existing session/history/receipt survives a template switch, foreign-host and revoked-session reads fail. No provider/message effect; disposable isolated fixtures cleaned up.

Actual Studio migration/toggles/Undo and commerce bag/checkout/mobile/service-family flows verified; canonical existing-data web smoke passes with local runtime identity unverified. Owned candidate types0 and Storefront build pass; separate API fixture and concurrent-work limitations are disclosed. No deployment.
